## Definition of Done — This Sprint

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — via automated test result OR documented manual evidence (screenshot, video, or playtest notes with sign-off)
- [ ] Test file exists at the specified path for all Logic and Integration stories — N/A this sprint (only S14-02 Option A may add 1-2 tests)
- [ ] Manual evidence document exists for Visual/Feel and UI stories — required at `production/qa/evidence/sprint-14-polish-010-evidence.md` (S14-02 Option A path)
- [ ] Smoke check passes (run `/smoke-check sprint` before QA hand-off)
- [ ] No regressions introduced — 1288/1288 PASS / 66th FFB preserved through all sprint-14 commits
- [ ] Code reviewed (via `/code-review` or documented peer review) — applicable to S14-02 Option A only; other stories are doc/admin tier
